destinations.name: Delhi
destinations.summary: India's capital and the primary Air India gateway — Mughal monuments, colonial-era boulevards, and the launch point for both the Cricket World Cup and Taj Holidays journeys.

destinations.name: Mumbai
destinations.summary: India's financial capital and secondary Air India gateway on the Arabian Sea, anchored by the Gateway of India and Marine Drive.

destinations.name: Johannesburg
destinations.summary: Gauteng's commercial hub and the Cricket World Cup 2027's African gateway — home to the Wanderers Stadium and Soweto's living history.

destinations.name: Cape Town
destinations.summary: Table Mountain, the Cape Peninsula, and Newlands Cricket Ground — host of marquee Cricket World Cup 2027 fixtures including the final.

destinations.name: Durban
destinations.summary: Subtropical Indian Ocean city with the Golden Mile beachfront and Kingsmead Stadium, one of world cricket's most storied grounds.

destinations.name: Centurion
destinations.summary: Home of SuperSport Park and a short drive from Pretoria's Union Buildings, within easy road reach of Johannesburg's OR Tambo hub.

destinations.name: Gqeberha
destinations.summary: Formerly Port Elizabeth — Algoa Bay beaches, St George's Park (the world's second-oldest Test venue), and gateway to Addo Elephant National Park.

destinations.name: Udaipur
destinations.summary: The City of Lakes, where the Taj Lake Palace floats on Lake Pichola beneath the City Palace ramparts.

destinations.name: Jaipur
destinations.summary: The Pink City — Amber Fort, Hawa Mahal, and the Taj Rambagh Palace, once the residence of the Maharajas of Jaipur.

destinations.name: Hyderabad
destinations.summary: City of Nizams and pearls, crowned by the Taj Falaknuma Palace above Charminar and Golconda Fort.

destinations.name: Kochi
destinations.summary: Fort Kochi's Chinese fishing nets and colonial harbour, with the Taj Malabar overlooking the confluence of sea and backwaters.

destinations.name: Alleppey
destinations.summary: Alappuzha's palm-fringed backwaters — the classic Kerala houseboat cruise through coconut-lined canals and paddy fields.

destinations.name: Goa
destinations.summary: Portuguese-era forts and palm-backed beaches, anchored by the Taj Fort Aguada on a 16th-century headland fortress.

destinations.name: Agra
destinations.summary: Home to the Taj Mahal itself — with a Taj Hotels property offering some of the closest sunrise views of the monument in the world.

destinations.name: Maldives
destinations.summary: Overwater villas on the Emboodhoo Lagoon at the Taj Exotica Resort & Spa, reached via a scenic speedboat transfer from Malé.
